name: Age of Arca
summary:
**Age of Arca** is a fast, aggressive, large-scale VR sci-fi horde shooter that drops you into the heart of a planetary war. Every mission is its own battle, and no two runs play out the same.

The desert planet ARIDUM-VII has been overrun by the Aberrants, a hostile alien swarm pouring out of nests across the planet.
